title: Eggcrafts
description: EggCrafts is a simple Data Pack for the game Minecraft that adds in recipes for majority of the spawn eggs in the vanilla game as well as for the mob spawner.
body:
EggCrafts is a simple Data Pack for the game Minecraft that adds in recipes for majority of the spawn eggs in the vanilla game as well as for the mob spawner.


Reference the Releases for public releases.





## Installation 1. You will first need to download the eggcraft.zip file in releases. After this, you will need to extract the zip file so that all you have is the folder eggcraft with the contents of data, pack.mcmeta, and pack.png inside. Again, it should not be a zip file, it should be a normal folder.

3. On World Creation, you will now have 3 tabs along the top of your screen: Game, World, More.



3. You will navigate to the More tab where you will find the buttons: Game Rules, Experiements, Data Packs



4. You will click on the Data packs button where you will now find yourself on the screen to select data packs.



5. At the bottom will be a Open Pack Folder button. After clicking this folder, a folder will pop up. You will simply drag and drop the eggcrafts folder into this folder.



6. You will now be able to click the data pack. After validation it will appear on the right side. If it fails validation, make sure that eggcrafts is not a zip file (eggcrafts.zip).





Congratulations! You should be able to play with the data pack and enjoy the new recipes.
